entities.summary: Laurent d'Arvieux was a political leaders in Marseille (1635-06-02, Marseille – 1702-10-03), recognized as a landmark figure in the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
